text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having run through the Stayers Stakes, 
Mejiro Bright saw her talent blossom.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho, the Kikuka Sho, and now 
this race—having achieved results at both 
middle and long distances, her grandmother 
finally acknowledged her talent as a 
versatile runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Carrying on the hopes of the Mejiro 
family, in order to walk the brilliant 
galaxy that their ancestor could not 
finish walking—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With renewed determination, Mejiro Bright 
set her sights on the race the Mejiro 
family valued most: the Tenno Sho 
(Spring).
